name: access-request-agent-eval
description: Evaluating a real multi-turn, tool-using LLM agent that handles IT access requests, reusing the policy engine from access-policy-compliance-eval, graded on tool use, clarification behavior, and decision correctness, using promptfoo. Runs the same agent loop against both Claude Sonnet 5 and GPT-4.1 for model comparison, and tracks real per-scenario API cost and latency alongside the grading. Includes scenario categories testing resistance to embedded prompt-injection instructions and refusal to fabricate answers outside what the agent's five tools can actually provide.
